author: GameTrailers
description: Astro Burn is available now from the App Store for iPhone and iPad. It is also available on PC and Android. Watch the Astro Burn launch trailer for this action-adventure shoot-em-up game inspired by 90s classics like Parodius and Pop N Twin Bee. Dodge everything. Destroy anything. Stack ridiculous snack powers and unleash anime-style Catnip-powered chaos in Astro Burn. Play as Astro, a space cat with her robot companion on their journey home, battling through absurd enemies, deadly hazards, and unhinged bosses.
title: Astro Burn - Official Apple iOS Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Raven’s Deal Halloween Event Trailer for Delta Force, the hit first-person action multiplayer game developed by Team Jade. Players can now duke it out in Raven's Deal to collect Major Event Tokens and attain Halloween-themed rewards in the Trickster Store. The Raven’s Deal Halloween Event is running now through November 9 in Delta Force for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, iOS, Android, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Delta Force - Official Raven’s Deal Halloween Event Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the 1.0 Launch Trailer for REKA, a cozy adventure RPG developed by Emberstone Entertainment. Players will explore a witch-centric world to aid the locals, meet creatures of the forest, and construct cottages to their heart's content. REKA is available now in Version 1.0 for PC (Steam).
title: REKA - Official 1.0 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Final Major Content Update Video for Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced, a remake of the hit entry in the stealth action-adventure franchise set in the age of piracy, developed by Ubisoft. Players can get a taste of what's in store with the game's final content offering, including New Game+, Nightmare Mode, brand-new takedowns, and tons of unlockable rewards to enjoy. The Final Major Content Update for Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced is launching on October 27 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced - Official Final Major Content Update

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out gameplay from Meltdown, an upcoming nuclear reactor desk-job simulation. Meltdown will be available on PC on November 9, 2026. An updated demo is out now on Steam.

Your resume got you the job. If you’d like to keep it, you’ll have to prevent an aging nuclear power plant from exploding.

Meltdown puts players behind the controls of a poorly maintained reactor responsible for powering the surrounding city. Connecting wires and regulating cooling water sounds manageable until everything needs attention at once while the boss bends your ear.
title: Meltdown - Official Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the trailer for the HumanitZ 1.1 Major Update. HumanitZ is an open-world zombie survival game where you scavenge, craft, build, and fight off the hordes, solo or with friends. The new update brings recruitable survivors, a new Headshot-Only Mode, and the ability to hunt yourself down. If you die after being bitten by a zeek, you'll turn into one! Come back, and you'll have to track down your former self, now a zeek, to get your gear back. The update also added tons of new features and a Halloween Event with themed quests, cosmetics, and weapons.
title: HumanitZ - Official 1.1 Major Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the latest League of Legends trailer for the MOBA to see what's new in League Classic. Mordekaiser, Hecarim, Yorick, and Lucian are now available in League Classic.
title: League of Legends - Official The Shadow Isles Rise in League Classic Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Main Battle Trailer for Goddess of Victory: Nikke, a sci-fi RPG shooter game developed by Shift Up. Players can fight towards the ultimate showdown with Chapter 49 and 50 looming on the horizon. Take the final stand with Chapter 49 and 50 of Goddess of Victory: Nikke, launching on October 29 for iOS and Android.
title: Goddess of Victory: Nikke - Official Main Battle Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the launch trailer for Crack, a co-op incremental adventure game developed by Rafoli. Players will join forces to take on an elusive lab experiment and crack open a giant egg by any means necessary. Seek the mysteries of Crack, available now on PC (Steam).
title: Crack - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at The Siege of Castle Doom Game Mode Trailer for Marvel Cosmic Invasion, a 2D action beat 'em up game developed by Tribute Games. Players must stop Victor von Doom's plans to activate the deadly Cosmic Inductor in the new DLC game mode by gathering Battery Cells, choosing paths, and stopping Doom. The Siege of Castle Doom Game Mode for Marvel Cosmic Invasion is launching on November 10 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Marvel Cosmic Invasion - Official The Siege of Castle Doom Game Mode Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the October 2026 Update Launch Trailer for Payday 3, a first-person heist shooter developed by Starbreeze. Players can now check out the October 2026 Update with the Feeding Frenzy side job, the Guns Blazin’ Crimebond adding akimbo weapons, a new Hardcore Challenge, PS5 Pro enhancements, and more. The October 2026 Update for Payday 3 is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Payday 3 - Official October 2026 Update Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Photo Mode Update Launch Trailer for Cronos: The New Dawn, a third-person survival horror shooter developed by Bloober Team. Players can now capture the frights and terrors of the arduous journey ahead with the Photo Mode Update to make use of the various camera settings, screen filters, and more. The Photo Mode Update is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam, GOG, and Epic Games Store).
title: Cronos: The New Dawn - Official Photo Mode Update Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's a look at the RTX Remix Modding Trailer for Minecraft, the hit creation adventure game developed by Mojang. Players can take a look at the RTX path tracing and DLSS implementation in the modding community for Minecraft. RTX Remix is available now for Minecraft.

Source: https://youtube.com/nvidia
title: Minecraft - Official RTX Remix Modding Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the launch trailer for Playable Archive, a micro psychological horror experience from developer DarkStone Digital (creator of The Mortuary Assistant). Step into Playable Archive as a young couple embarks on their first home remodel. While demolishing the dilapidated home, they stumble upon elements of its hidden past awakening something set in motion long ago. The only hope of survival is decoding the many mysteries revealed through time. Playable Archive is out now on Steam.
title: Playable Archive - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: If you've ever wondered what a fusion of Vampire Survivors and Heroes of Might and Magic would look like, then Heroes Never Die might be the game for you. It's a newly announced fantasy strategy game from developer Ludogram that "aims to take the best of the survival formula and fuse it with more tactical decisions, real-time army building, and powerful fantasy heroes." It will be released in 2027 for PC. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5275640/Heroes_Never_Die/
title: Heroes Never Die: Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Snowbloom Wishsong outfit preview in this latest trailer for the action-adventure fashion game, Infinity Nikki. Infinity Nikki is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), iOS, Android, and Pc. Infinity Nikki's Version 2.11: Tales Woven in Time will be available on October 29, 2026 (UTC-7).
title: Infinity Nikki - Official Whimsical Reverie: Snowbloom Wishsong Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Luka Skill Overview Trailer for Monster Hunter Outlanders, an upcoming mobile action monster-hunting RPG developed by TiMi Studio Group and Capcom. Players can embark on grand hunts with Luka, a bow-wielding hero who can leverage lightning arrows and fast mobility to keep the pressure up in any engagement. Fight as Luka in Monster Hunter Outlanders, launching on October 29 for iOS and Android.
title: Monster Hunter Outlanders - Official Luka Skill Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the NieR:Automata Trailer for Stellar Blade, the hit third-person action RPG developed by Shift Up. Players can acquire Stellar Tears throughout the adventure to access cosmetic items based on the iconic NieR:Automata IP. Take a look at the NieR:Automata-themed available in Stellar Blade, launching on November 4 for Nintendo Switch 2, with the game being available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam).
title: Stellar Blade - Official NieR:Automata Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss 'The Zone Lookout' Update 2.1 Launch Trailer for Stalker 2: Heart of Chornobyl, the hit first-person open-world survival game developed by GSC Game World. Players can access new features and additions with the latest update, including refined long-range combat, fast travel to known destinations, a suite of fixes and adjustments, and more. Update 2.1 for Stalker 2: Heart of Chornobyl is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam, GOG, Epic Games Store).

#Stalker2HeartOfChornobyl #Gaming #IGN
title: Stalker 2: Heart of Chornobyl - Official 'The Zone Lookout' Update 2.1 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Drawquarium gets a new trailer and a release date. Chase your dreams in the Drawquarium release date trailer for this upcoming sim game. In Drawquarium, draw your very own fish and build a cozy little aquarium. And if you like, set it as your animated desktop wallpaper! Watch your drawings come to life. Feed them, raise them and collect golden scales to unlock new decorations. There's also some handy tools to help you focus and unwind. Drawquarium will be available on PC (Steam) on November 13, 2026.
title: Drawquarium - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get another look at the unsettling world of Ayasa: Shadows of Silence in this console launch trailer for the dark puzzle-platformer game told without spoken words. In Ayasa: Shadows of Silence, explore six surreal lands, use light to reveal paths, and solve environmental puzzles. Your acts of compassion or indifference can shape the fate of a world on the edge of ruin. Ayasa: Shadows of Silence is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC (Epic Games Store and Steam).
title: Ayasa: Shadows of Silence - Official Console Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out gameplay and the cute world of Pao Pao in this Early Access launch trailer for the co-op adventure sim game. Welcome to PAO PAO! Discover a cozy seaside town full of little joys, where you can play solo or in co-op with up to three friends. Cook delicious meals, go fishing, grow crops, and create a home of your own by the sea. Pao Pao is available now on Xbox and Steam.
title: Pao Pao - Official Early Access Launch Trailer
